title: Meet: NotPaté
description: A series of motion graphic assets for NotCo, the AI-powered food technology company behind Not Burger, Not Milk and Not Chicken — one of Latin America's most recognizable food-tech brands.
challenge: NotCo's content team needed high-velocity animated assets for product launches and social campaigns that could match the energy of a fast-moving consumer brand while staying on-brand with their bold, punchy visual identity.
solution: Developed a rapid-production motion template system in After Effects that allowed NotCo's team to swap product shots and copy while maintaining full animation quality. Designed for speed without sacrificing craft.
result: The template system reduced asset production time by 60% for their in-house team. Over 40 animated posts were produced across three product lines in a single quarter.
